signal: Zuddl is sponsoring the Experiential Marketing Summit 2026 in Las Vegas and positioning around event tech stack management

email.body1:
Paul, saw Zuddl is sponsoring the Experiential Marketing Summit 2026 and leaning into event tech stack management.

A presence like that surfaces more co-sell and partner accounts than the team can personally work, so partner-sourced pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across the partner ecosystem on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Zuddl's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack data, and accounts showing those signals tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: three drafts to top partner targets
email.body2:
Paul, quick follow-up for Zuddl.

The hard part of co-sell is consistent, personalized outreach to the right accounts inside each partner's book, which is exactly what falls through the cracks at scale. That is where partner-sourced pipeline stalls.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to top accounts in your partner ecosystem. Want to hop on a quick 15-minute call and I will walk you through them?
email.body3:
Paul, last bit of proof for Zuddl.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Zuddl's reply rate likely compares to other event-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Paul, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling co-sell pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running sales and partnerships together is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your partner motion? I will tailor it to Zuddl either way.
